Malaysia started sending back around 1,500 Myanmar nationals yesterday.

 Sending people back into an active civil war feels reckless no matter how you frame the immigration numbers.

Especially with last day's airstrike on Rakhine State https://t.co/FDC0rc3gkg

RT @UN_News_Centre: At least 50 reportedly killed as an airstrike hits a crowded market in Myanmar’s Rakhine state.

@antonioguterres calls…
Chinese pressure keeps shaping the MNDAA-regime talks. When Beijing talks, both sides listen. Northern Myanmar is slowly turning into a Chinese sphere whether locals want it or not.
